{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check sites after deduplication
print(f'Sites present after deduplication: {sorted(df_dedup["site"].unique())}')

# Compute response rate per site
response_rate = df_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()
print(f'Response rates by site:\n{response_rate}')"}
